post.caption:
The ten percent myth is one of the most repeated wrong things about the human body. Scans show activity everywhere, including during sleep, and there is no dormant region waiting to be unlocked. But the strongest argument is not scanning, it is cost. Your brain is 2% of your body weight and burns around 20% of your total energy. Nothing that expensive survives evolution while sitting idle.
